sessionStart.prompt: When creating or editing customization assets, enforce naming and frontmatter rules: agent files as role.agent.md with name and description, instruction files as *.instructions.md with applyTo and description, skill files as SKILL.md with name and description, and plugin manifests with valid component path mappings. These assets load in both GitHub Copilot and Claude Code from a single copy, so also enforce the dual-host rules: never pin a model in an agent (record the preference in a ## Model body section instead, because Claude refuses to load an agent whose model id it does not recognise); author agent tools as Copilot tool ids only and let scripts/Sync-ClaudePlugins.ps1 append the Claude equivalents; document every handoff target in the agent body because Claude ignores the handoffs key; reference instruction files explicitly by path because Claude does not auto-apply applyTo; keep host-specific tool names out of skill prose; and use only type: prompt hooks. Author the Copilot manifest and hooks.json, never the generated .claude-plugin/ or hooks/ files, and run the sync script before committing. Full rules: docs/copilot/claude-code-compatibility.md. Keep every authored asset concise: state each rule in exactly one file and point at it by relative path from everywhere else, delete any sentence that does not change behavior versus the model default, and stay inside the body budgets (SKILL.md 40 lines, *.instructions.md 60, *.agent.md 80) or state why the asset exceeds one. Full rules: plugins/spec-builder/instructions/authoring/spec-conciseness.instructions.md.
